description: An already-running database addressed by DSN; the stand provisions and deploys nothing.

fields.name: protocol
fields.description: Wire protocol stroppy speaks to this database.
fields.title: Protocol

fields.name: dsn
fields.description: Full connection string including credentials; stored encrypted and never rendered into logs or artifacts.
fields.title: DSN

fields.name: tls_skip_verify
fields.description: Accept the server certificate without checking the chain or hostname; needed for self-signed stands, never for a shared endpoint.
fields.title: Skip TLS verification

fields.name: probe_query
fields.description: Statement run once before the workload to prove the DSN works and the database answers.
fields.title: Probe query

fields.name: truncate_before_run
fields.description: Let the workload drop and recreate its own tables. Off by default: this database is not ours to wipe.
fields.title: Clean before run
